result.summary: The main visual issue is a layout/content error on the bottom-most card in the list, which contains a discount label (-0%) that appears incorrect, and the card lacks a title or restaurant name compared to the other cards displayed.

issues.description: The bottom card showing a pizza is missing its restaurant name/title, unlike all other cards on the page.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant name and relevant metadata (rating, delivery time) are dynamically populated for this card.

issues.description: The discount tag on the pizza card displays '-0%', which provides no meaningful information to the user and appears to be a data rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount label if the discount value is 0 or invalid.
